name: PokéForge
headline: Companion
confirmBody: {action}. This uses your in-game inventory or earned token balance. It does not charge money.
currencyHint: Earned in-game balance · no cash value
mode_catching: Grow your current companion and hatch new Pokémon.
mode_training: Build your trainee’s XP and effort values. Catching is paused.
mode_balanced: Split tokens evenly between catching and training.
noTrainee: No eligible trainee. Tokens go to catching until one is available.
emptyCollection: Your collection starts with the first hatch.
recordHint: This is the collection record date, not necessarily the hatch or trade date.
costHint: Provider-reported amounts and token-price estimates are not necessarily charges to your account.
noUsage: No usage has been loaded yet. Refresh, or check scan folders in PokéForge Settings.
stale: Usage may be out of date
bagIntro: Items and Poké Balls for your next session.
queueAction: Equip or queue one {name} for the next egg
rareCandy_hint: Adds one level to your selected trainee. No EVs or catch-progress boost.
mint_hint: Rerolls your active companion’s nature. Its progress stays intact.
shinyCharm_hint: A permanent boost to shiny odds while you own it.
pokeBall_hint: 20% fewer incubation tokens for one egg.
quickBall_hint: 60% fewer incubation tokens for one egg.
greatBall_hint: 2× rare-or-better hatch weight for one egg.
luxuryBall_hint: One egg hatches at level 10, without extra EVs.
ultraBall_hint: 4× rare-or-better hatch weight for one egg.
ballHint: Optional. Free eggs still hatch normally. Equipping an untouched egg consumes the ball; otherwise it is consumed when the next cycle starts.
toolOpen: Open the PokéForge companion dashboard, collection, training, usage and bag. Starts its bundled local engine automatically; no menu-bar app installation is needed.
toolRead: Read current Pokémon, ownership, training, inventory and usage from the running local PokéForge engine. Never edits saves.
toolUpdate: Perform an explicitly requested PokéForge action. Values: mode=catching/training/balanced; focus=hp/attack/defense/special-attack/special-defense/speed; target/candy=owned Pokémon ID; mint=active ID; buyItem/buyBall/queueBall=catalog ID; openNative=trade/settings. Purchases require expectedPrice from the latest snapshot. Candy, mint and purchases consume in-game resources: get user intent for that exact action first. Never automatically retry an uncertain outcome.
toolResult: PokéForge state loaded from the local PokéForge engine.

errors.engine_offline: PokéForge is not connected yet. Try again in a moment.
errors.unsafe_socket: The local bridge has unexpected permissions. Restart PokéForge to restore its private connection.
errors.invalid_response: The engine returned an unreadable response. Restart PokéForge and try again.
errors.invalid_request: That action is not supported or has expired. Refresh and try again.
errors.outcome_unknown: The connection ended before confirmation. Refresh and check your inventory before repeating the action.
errors.price_changed: The price changed. Refresh the shop before buying.
errors.unavailable: That action is no longer available. Check your balance, inventory and training target.
errors.save_failed: The engine could not save the change. It restored the previous game state. Check disk space and folder permissions.
errors.host_connection: The host connection is unavailable. Reopen the panel or use the local dashboard.
errors.busy: The engine is busy. Wait a moment, then refresh.
errors.engine_platform: The PokéForge engine currently requires macOS 14 or newer.
errors.engine_invalid: The bundled engine could not be verified. Reinstall the PokéForge plugin. If this persists, clear its plugin-engines cache in Application Support/PokeTokenBar.
errors.engine_start_failed: PokéForge could not start its engine. Quit an older PokéForge or PokeTokenBar app and try again. macOS Privacy & Security may need to approve the signed engine.
